candidate.title: loadUsers wraps validation errors as 500 and leaks Prisma error messages as 400
reports: packages/features/bookings/lib/handlenewbooking.ts:727 — an empty/missing dynamicuserlist now throws a generic error that becomes a 500 instead of the previous empty-result path that produced a 4xx dynamic-booking error

in packages/features/bookings/lib/handlenewbooking.ts loadusers (~722-760), validation failures are thrown as plain error objects instead of httperror, causing the catch block to misclassify client-input errors as a generic 500 instead of a 400

[low/security] packages/features/bookings/lib/handlenewbooking.ts:~755-760 — loadusers' catch rethrows prisma.prismaclientknownrequesterror messages verbatim as a 400 response, leaking internal database error details to api clients and miscategorizing a server-side failure as a client error.

loadusers catch in packages/features/bookings/lib/handlenewbooking.ts (~744-757) misclassifies server-side prisma.prismaclientknownrequesterror as a 400 client error, converts the deliberate dynamicuserlist error into an opaque 500, and never logs the original error, losing root causes and correct status codes for monitoring

[medium/security] packages/features/bookings/lib/handlenewbooking.ts:~750 (loadusers catch) — prisma.prismaclientknownrequesterror is rethrown as httperror({ statuscode: 400, message: error.message }), leaking raw internal database error details (table/field/meta info) to api clients and misclassifying server-side db errors as client errors.

[advisory] loadusers' catch maps prismaclientknownrequesterror to a 400 and replaces every other failure with a generic 500 without logging the original error anywhere. database failures during booking are reported as client errors (400) carrying the raw prisma message, and genuine server faults produce a 500 with no diagnostic trail for whoever debugs the incident.
